patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Painful blistering rash on one side
clinical.quoteLong: I've got burning, stabbing pain and a blistery stripe along one side of my ribs. It stops at the middle and doesn't cross over. The pain started days before the rash.
clinical.presentationShort: 62yo F ? burning pain followed by a one-sided stripe of grouped blisters along the ribs; stops at midline, no eye or facial involvement.
clinical.presentationLong: 62-year-old female with several days of burning pain followed by grouped blisters in a narrow stripe along one side of her ribs. The rash stops at the midline, with no facial or eye involvement.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → antivirals (best within 72h), analgesia; check for eye/facial involvement (none here); discharge.
diagnosis.why: Dermatomal vesicles that stop at the midline = shingles. Antivirals early; watch the eye (V1) — that's the dangerous one.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 62-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: lifting the hem of her shirt slightly to show a rash along one side of her ribs. Expression: uncomfortable, wincing. Clearly visible: a stripe of red blistery rash on one side of the torso. No text, no logos.
